eyebrow: Formula: AR(1) and the unit root
code:
X_t = phi * X_(t-1) + eps_t

# |phi| < 1  -> stationary, shocks decay
# phi == 1   -> unit root (random walk):
#              X_t = X_(t-1) + eps_t
#              shocks never decay,
#              variance grows without bound
caption: A unit root (phi = 1) is the textbook signature of non-stationarity.

code:
from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import adfuller

result = adfuller(log_returns, autolag="AIC")
adf_stat, p_value = result[0], result[1]

# H0: series HAS a unit root (non-stationary)
# low p-value -> reject H0 -> stationary
caption: ADF's null hypothesis is non-stationarity — a low p-value is the good outcome.
